backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a property development management system with CRUD operations for properties, projects, tasks, team members, and user profiles, all protected by role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four main features (Properties, Projects, Tasks, and Team pages) with their associated files, components, test IDs, and high confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and styling for the property development management application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a professional OKLCH color system for light and dark modes with corporate navy, slate, and teal palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the PropDev Manager application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for properties, projects, tasks, and team pages, plus authentication flow and profile setup modal integration.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner component displaying a gradient overlay with application title and tagline for property development management.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing consistent page structure with navigation header and footer containing Caffeine.ai attribution across all routes.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component managing Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar with logo, icon-based links to Properties/Projects/Tasks/Team pages, active route highlighting, and login button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog component for initial user profile setup, collecting name, email, and department with form validation. Prevents closing until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/ProjectCard.tsx: Card component displaying development project details including budget, phase, dates, and associated property. Provides edit and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProjectFilters.t: Filter component for projects with property dropdown selector and clear filter button. Shows active filter state.
frontend/src/components/ProjectForm.tsx: Dialog form for creating and editing development projects with fields for name, description, budget, dates, phase, and property association. Handles bigint conversions for dates and budget.
frontend/src/components/PropertyCard.tsx: Card component displaying property information including type, status badge, address, and dates. Provides edit and delete action buttons with status-based color coding.
Filter component with dropdowns for property status and type filtering. Includes clear filters button when filters are active.
frontend/src/components/PropertyForm.tsx: Dialog form for creating and editing properties with fields for name, address, type, status, and dates. Handles bigint conversions for date timestamps.
frontend/src/components/TaskCard.tsx: Displays a task card with name, description, status, priority, assigned team member, and due date. Includes edit and delete action buttons with color-coded badges for status and priority.
frontend/src/components/TaskFilters.tsx: Provides filter controls for tasks by status, priority, and assigned team member with dropdown selects. Includes a clear filters button when any filters are active.
frontend/src/components/TaskForm.tsx: Dialog form for creating or editing tasks with fields for name, description, project, team member assignment, status, priority, and due date. Handles form state and submission with validation.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberCard.t: Displays a team member card showing name, role, email, and assigned projects. Includes edit and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberForm.t: Dialog form for adding or editing team members with fields for principal ID (new only), name, role, email, and project assignments via checkboxes. Handles form state and submission.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity state management. Creates AuthClient with configurable options and handles identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on user profiles, properties, projects, tasks, and team members, using the actor from useActor and managing query cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a professional corporate theme supporting light and dark modes, plus a hero section background image utility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Page component for managing development projects with filtering by property, CRUD operations, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/PropertiesPage.tsx: Page component for managing properties with filtering by status and type, CRUD operations, hero section, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/TasksPage.tsx: Page component for managing tasks organized by project, with filtering by status, priority, and assigned team member, plus CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/TeamPage.tsx: Page component for managing team members with CRUD operations, displaying members in a grid layout with project assignment information.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with container settings, border radius variables, custom animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata file describing a full-stack property development and project management application with features for tracking properties, projects, tasks, and team members, including architectural notes and image requirements.
